target: human_study/evo/METHODS_COMPARISON.md (sections A and B) and VERIFICATION.md wording
claim: Statements that claim more than was shown: (a) METHODS_COMPARISON.md:24-25 attributes the face twist to 'cervical coupled axial rotation driven by the facets', but it was the applied Rz (F-0001). (b) :26 says 'M3 <= mu -> safe for sure; M2 > mu -> slips for sure'. Neither is a proven bound. Both are computed from the TIED solution, whose load sharing (how much goes through the facets, ligaments and cage) and pressure map change once sliding is allowed. M3 also discards the glue tension (P_i = 0) without re-solving, and uses element-centre stress rather than interface traction (F-0010). (c) :37-44 recommends an explicit TLED solver and :55 a kinetic-energy gate, but the accepted solver is implicit Newton (DECISIONS.md:726). The document has gone stale, and the Newton-specific risks (F-0004) have no gate. (d) :40 'credibility here by verification against FEBio' and the claim of ASME V&V 40 style: V&V 40 also requires validation against physical data for the context of use, and none is planned. (e) VERIFICATION.md:11-12 report PASS without saying the passes were with the superseded solver (F-0004), and give the 8 % friction gap as a FEBio deficiency without evidence (F-0005).
evidence: Cited lines; F-0001 (r0001_i001: twist tracks the applied Rz at 0.83-0.88); DECISIONS.md:726; gate scripts use solver.Solver (F-0004).
how_to_reproduce: Read METHODS_COMPARISON.md:24-26, 37-44, 55 and VERIFICATION.md:11-12 next to the evidence of F-0001 / F-0004 / F-0005.

fix_options.option: Rewrite section A: remove the facet-coupling explanation, mark the table invalid (F-0002), and phrase M2 / M3 as 'heuristic indicators from the tied state, not bounds' until a real-friction comparison shows which side they fall on
Update section B to the accepted Newton + explicit friction design, replace gate 5 by Newton-relevant checks (convergence, increment-size invariance of cage translation), add a validation item
VERIFICATION.md: one column 'solver used' per gate; move the FEBio-0.457 remark to an open item until explained

summary_zh: 方法比較與驗證紀錄兩份文件中，有幾處說得比證據更多。（一）把扭矩解釋成「小面關節帶動的耦合旋轉」是錯的，真正原因是負荷曲線錯誤。（二）文件寫「保守摩擦指標低於摩擦係數就一定安全，樂觀指標高於摩擦係數就一定滑動」，但這兩個指標都是從「cage 被黏住」的解算出來的；一旦允許滑動，力的分配會改變，所以都不是經過證明的上下限。（三）文件仍在推薦顯式求解器和動能檢查，但主持人已核准牛頓法，文件已經過時。（四）文件自稱依照醫療器材模擬標準 ASME V&V 40，但該標準也要求以實體實驗驗證，計畫中卻沒有。（五）驗證紀錄沒有註明「通過」用的是舊求解器。
